## 更新内容 / Changes

- Add a read-only storage inventory for managed instances and recognized legacy instance archives. It reports logical file size, file counts and categories for conversation files, SQLite databases, configuration, skills, cache and other files.
- Scan only manager-owned instance and archive directories, skip symbolic links and external workspaces, and stop with a partial-result notice at file-count, nesting-depth or time limits. Legacy archives without a manifest are identified as unknown; this release does not restore or delete archive contents.
- Explain that APFS clones may share blocks, so allocated-block totals are estimates and do not represent guaranteed reclaimable space.

新增只读“存储清单”，盘点受管实例和可识别的旧实例归档，按会话文件、SQLite 数据库、配置、技能、缓存及其他文件展示逻辑大小与文件数。

扫描仅进入管理器拥有的实例和归档目录，跳过符号链接及外部工作目录；达到文件数、目录深度或扫描耗时上限时会停止并注明结果不完整。缺少归档清单的旧目录会标为来源未知；本版不会恢复或删除归档内容。

清单同时提示：APFS 快照可能共享数据块，因此文件系统分配空间只是估算，不代表必然可回收空间。

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 SHA256SUMS.txt。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with SHA256SUMS.txt. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 验证来源 / Verification

Validation: 1,507 source tests passed, 4 environment-conditional tests skipped, 0 failed. The storage inventory regression verifies managed files, legacy trash labels, symlink exclusion, external workspace exclusion, read-only behavior and bounded partial scans. Typecheck and production build passed; the isolated desktop Agent Manager workflow smoke passed.

Source commit, version tag, matching GitHub Actions release run, and SHA256SUMS.txt links will be added after publication.
